requirements.quote:
Once the handshake is complete, it is possible for either side to
   update its sending traffic keys using the KeyUpdate handshake message
   defined in Section 4.6.3.  The next generation of traffic keys is
   computed by generating client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N+1
   from client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N as described in this
   section and then re-deriving the traffic keys as described in
   Section 7.3.
requirements.condition: a side updates its sending traffic keys
requirements.required_behavior: perform the update only after the handshake is complete
requirements.why_checkable: A pre-handshake KeyUpdate can be rejected and state transitions inspected.

requirements.quote:
Once the handshake is complete, it is possible for either side to
   update its sending traffic keys using the KeyUpdate handshake message
   defined in Section 4.6.3.  The next generation of traffic keys is
   computed by generating client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N+1
   from client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N as described in this
   section and then re-deriving the traffic keys as described in
   Section 7.3.
requirements.condition: a side initiates an update of its sending traffic keys
requirements.why_checkable: The update trigger and emitted handshake message are observable.

requirements.quote:
computed by generating client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N+1
   from client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N as described in this
   section and then re-deriving the traffic keys as described in
   Section 7.3.

   The next-generation application_traffic_secret is computed as:

       application_traffic_secret_N+1 =
           HKDF-Expand-Label(application_traffic_secret_N,
                             "traffic upd", "", Hash.length)
requirements.why_checkable: All expansion arguments and the output length are fixed and vector-testable.

requirements.quote:
computed by generating client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N+1
   from client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N as described in this
   section and then re-deriving the traffic keys as described in
   Section 7.3.
requirements.required_behavior: re-derive its associated traffic keys as specified in Section 7.3
requirements.why_checkable: The next secret-to-key derivation and ordering can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
Once client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N+1 and its associated
   traffic keys have been computed, implementations SHOULD delete
   client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N and its associated
   traffic keys.
requirements.condition: application_traffic_secret_N+1 and its associated traffic keys have been computed
requirements.why_checkable: Prior-generation secret storage can be inspected after the update.

requirements.quote:
Once client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N+1 and its associated
   traffic keys have been computed, implementations SHOULD delete
   client_/server_application_traffic_secret_N and its associated
   traffic keys.
requirements.condition: application_traffic_secret_N+1 and its associated traffic keys have been computed
requirements.required_behavior: delete the traffic keys associated with application_traffic_secret_N
requirements.why_checkable: Prior-generation key storage can be inspected after the update.
